ValidationRule.description: 2025: Logic added to account for Business Only portal
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ispickval (Accepted__c, "Yes") && isblank (text(Scheduled_Program_Start_Date__c)) && isblank (Program_Re_Engagement_Date__c) && not (or(ispickval (Program_Site_Track__c, "Business Only"),ispickval (Program_Site_Track__c, "Workshop Direct")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For accepted Classic and Cleanslate Direct participants, enter 'Program Start Date, Cohort'. For accepted Connects Direct and Workshop Direct, enter 'Program Start Date, Non-Cohort'.
